summary: A website with an interactive map of the moon and mars with that has the abandoned hardware and the forgotten machines. This map will tell a story of every piece how it landed there and it's properties and a game that you play as an astronauts on mars and the moon and you encounter the abandoned hardware and the story is told for the piece when you get near it. this will solve the problem of lack of knowledge among the people and make the knowledge spreads. it's important as we reach the cosmos and reach success we need to remember our struggles and fails.
details:
It combines an overhead interactive GIS map of the Moon and Mars with a 3D browser-based exploration game. Users can explore landing sites, examine historical machinery data, or control an astronaut avatar walking across planetary surfaces. When the player gets close to an abandoned piece of hardware, its historical story, properties, and landing logs unlock automatically.

Transforms passive reading into active discovery, raises public awareness of our off-world material footprint, and builds emotional empathy for the struggles and trials of early space exploration.

To bridge the knowledge gap about space debris and forgotten missions among the general public, and to remind humanity that as we reach new heights in the cosmos, we must honor the failures and struggles that paved the way.

  • Frontend & Web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (React or Vue.js).
  • 3D & Graphics: WebGL / Three.js for rendering the astronaut and planetary terrains.
  • Mapping: Leaflet.js or Mapbox integrated with planetary cartography data.
  • Design & Modeling: Blender (for low-poly 3D models of rovers/landers) and Figma (for UI/UX).

It gamifies space archaeology by turning a dry historical database into an immersive adventure game. It uses spatial proximity-based storytelling—unlocking lore only when you physically "walk" up to the machine—and bridges macro data maps with micro personal experiences.

  • Historical & Scientific Fidelity: Ensuring accurate rover/lander locations and specs from real mission data.
  • Web Performance: Optimizing 3D graphics and heavy maps to run smoothly inside standard web browsers without high-end gaming hardware.
  • Emotional Tone: Designing an atmosphere of quiet reflection to honor early human struggles.
